decision_rule: Require valid paired results on Gemini Flash-Lite, weak-model Gemma 4 and the same-family Nemotron analogue across classification, regression and ranking; valid facts may not decline, quote rejection must decline, and all schema/citation/public gates must pass.

flash_lite.asymmetric_case: rates quote arm had transient 503 while evidence-ID arm succeeded; excluded from quality comparison.

gemma4.configuration_issue: The run did not set the documented Gemma 4 thinking level to minimal; Gemini 2.5 thinkingBudget is not the Gemma control.

hypothesis: Prompt-local evidence IDs let remote models select grounded evidence more reliably and concisely than copying exact quotes.

nemotron.reason: Not run because the required weak-model gate did not produce a valid pair.

production_change: none; candidate code and tests restored to the committed baseline.
reason: Flash-Lite preserved all valid facts on complete pairs and reduced prompt/completion size, but the weak-model run produced no valid paired model rows and the predeclared three-model, three-target-type gate could not be evaluated.
